_readme: Retry policies consumed on BOTH sides of a language boundary. Only the events-rejection policy qualifies today: the CLI's streamevents LOOKUP_FAILED retry and the browser's useWatchEventsStreams rejectionBackoff must advance on the same schedule or a rejected batch retried by one side lands in a rhythm the other side's accounting does not expect. Frontend-only retry policies deliberately stay in the frontend (useOpsSubmitter, useUserEvents, workerPrivateEvents): no mirror, no contract to hold.
